environments.web: Google Chrome mobile viewport 390x844 against local PHP build and live Railway access checks
environments.android: Android 8.0 API 26 emulator, Android Studio bundled OpenJDK 25.0.2

results.name: Signed-out login gate
results.evidence: Both /index.php and /discounts.php returned HTTP 200 without a session; the local browser also opened home without redirecting to login.

results.name: Member sign-in
results.evidence: The local member demo signed in successfully and reached profile, then home. Credentials were not written to this report.

results.name: Simplified navigation and scrolling
results.evidence: Four primary task cards, five menu destinations, all primary pages, and scrolling at 200 percent browser zoom passed.

results.name: Build and unit tests
results.evidence: Debug build passed on OpenJDK 25.0.2; 6 unit tests passed with zero failures.

results.name: API 26 connected UI tests
results.evidence: 6 device tests passed with zero failures: login gate, recovery and registration reachability, home actions, scrolling, schedule filtering, persistence, and demonstration-event safety.

results.name: Mouse or touch scrolling on login
results.evidence: The page scrolled from the upper login fields to Sign In and Create an Account on the API 26 emulator.

results.name: Build and safety tests
results.evidence: Xcode test succeeded; both CommunityEventSafetyTests passed.

results.name: Fresh signed-out launch
results.evidence: A clean install launched on the redesigned login screen with Sign In, Register, Forgot Password, and Create an Account visible.

results.name: Full UI login and five-tab navigation
results.evidence: Simulator UI control was confirmed, but the coordinate-driven sign-in attempt was interrupted before a valid end-to-end assertion. No pass is claimed.

results.name: Live authentication lifecycle
results.evidence: Health 200, readiness 200, registration 201, login 200, authenticated profile 200, and account deletion 200. All disposable accounts were deleted.

results.name: Live password-reset email
results.evidence: Forgot-password returned HTTP 503 because a verified SMTP sender is not configured. A six-digit code cannot currently reach a real inbox.

notRun: Manual 200 percent system font-scale journey on both mobile platforms
UAT with six elderly BKK participants
releaseDecision: NO-GO until the website login gate and live reset-email delivery are fixed and retested.
